description: Fixture (ACCDB): the R-FMT-2 world tables plus objects the engine itself creates and a front end would also carry: saved queries (select, parameter, action, join), a foreign-key relationship, database/table/field user and Description properties, and the engine's system tables and containers. Created by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE Nums (K LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Nums PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 1 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 2 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 4 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 8 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 16 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 32 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 64 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 128 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 256 FROM Nums
INSERT INTO Nums (K) SELECT K + 512 FROM Nums
CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, B DOUBLE, N TEXT(100), V TEXT(255), Y YESNO, D DATETIME)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_T_A ON T (A)
INSERT INTO T (ID, A, B, N, V, Y, D) SELECT K, K * 10, K * 1.5, IIf(K Mod 7 = 0, Null, 'row ' & K), 'v' & K, CBool(K Mod 2), #1/1/2000# FROM Nums WHERE K <= 40
CREATE TABLE Dense (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Dense PRIMARY KEY, A TEXT(255), B TEXT(255), C TEXT(255))

INSERT INTO Dense (ID, A, B, C) SELECT K, 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb', 'c' FROM Nums WHERE K <= 14
CREATE TABLE G (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_G PRIMARY KEY, S1 TEXT(255), S2 TEXT(255))

INSERT INTO G (ID, S1, S2) SELECT K, 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx', 'yyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy' FROM Nums WHERE K <= 5
CREATE TABLE Ix (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Ix PRIMARY KEY, W TEXT(40))
INSERT INTO Ix (ID, W) SELECT K, 'k' & Format(K * 10, '000') FROM Nums WHERE K <= 30
CREATE TABLE IxL (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_IxL PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO IxL (ID) SELECT K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 598
INSERT INTO Sl (F) SELECT True FROM Nums WHERE K <= 253
CREATE TABLE Bo (F1 YESNO, F2 YESNO, F3 YESNO)
INSERT INTO Bo (F1, F2, F3) SELECT CBool(K Mod 2), CBool(K Mod 3), False FROM Nums WHERE K <= 60
CREATE TABLE Bo2 (F1 YESNO, F2 YESNO, F3 YESNO)
INSERT INTO Bo2 (F1, F2, F3) SELECT CBool(K Mod 2), CBool(K Mod 3), False FROM Nums WHERE K <= 60
ALTER TABLE Bo2 ADD COLUMN Tx TEXT(100)
CREATE TABLE Alt (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Alt PRIMARY KEY, A TEXT(20), B TEXT(20), C LONG, D TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO Alt (ID, A, B, C, D) SELECT K, 'a' & K, 'b' & K, K * 100, 'd' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 20
CREATE TABLE Fv (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Fv PRIMARY KEY, U LONG, P LONG, Q TEXT(10) NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Fv_U ON Fv (U)
INSERT INTO Fv (ID, U, P, Q) SELECT K, K * 10, K, 'q' & K FROM Nums WHERE K <= 5
CREATE TABLE Tg (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Tg PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(50), M MEMO)
CREATE TABLE Sc (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Sc PRIMARY KEY, Fb BYTE, Fi SHORT, Fl LONG, Fs SINGLE, Fd DOUBLE, Fc CURRENCY, Ft DATETIME, Fg GUID)
ALTER TABLE Sc ADD COLUMN Fx DATETIME2
CREATE TABLE Lv (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Lv PRIMARY KEY, M MEMO, O LONGBINARY)
CREATE TABLE Parent (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Parent PRIMARY KEY, Nm TEXT(20))
CREATE TABLE Child (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Child PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG, [Note] TEXT(20))
SELECT ID, A, N FROM T WHERE ID < 10 ORDER BY ID;
PARAMETERS pId Long; SELECT * FROM T WHERE ID = pId;
UPDATE T SET B = B WHERE ID < 0;
SELECT Child.ID, Parent.Nm FROM Parent INNER JOIN Child ON Parent.ID = Child.PID;
